source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text:
Good news, https://drivereel.example is back up. I restored the DNS records and the site is serving normally again.

One thing left: https://www.drivereel.example. The DNS is pointing to Firebase correctly, but the domain itself got dropped from the Firebase Hosting config, so it shows a "Site Not Found" page. I don't have access to Firebase, so I can't add it back — but it's a quick fix on your side:

1\. Go to <http://console.firebase.google.com|console.firebase.google.com> and open the DriveReel project
2\. In the left menu, click Hosting
3\. Find the drivereel-main site and click "Add custom domain"
4\. Enter: https://www.drivereel.example
5\. Choose the option to redirect it to an existing site, and select https://drivereel.example
6\. Click through to finish — the DNS records it asks for are already in place, so you can just confirm

The SSL certificate takes a few hours to issue after that, so www may show a warning until it's done. Nothing else needs changing.

Let me know once it's added and I'll verify it's resolving correctly.
